profile.lastName: Knight Brown, P.E., DHS Trusted Tester
profile.headline: CEO | Web Developer | Digital Accessibility Consultant
profile.summary: I am a web development and engineering professional wielding a blend of leadership, business, and technical knowledge of the digital marketing, aerospace and energy industries.  I have a proven ability to perform analysis, identify significant findings, and communicate results effectively.  I have a high proficiency in performing quality assurance checks, research, and computations.  I am educated in managing technical professionals and increasing innovation.  I am experienced in leading others to achieve distinct goals by developing generative action plans.

positions.title: Owner, Lead Web Developer
positions.description:
▸ Designs and updates websites to meet the specifications and functionalities requested by clients

▸ Tests and remediates websites to conform to Section 508 and WCAG accessibility criteria

▸ Analyzes website and social media data to improve performance

▸ Highly skilled at editing code in various programming languages, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript and PHP

▸ Experienced in WordPress and proficient with all major page builders

▸ Proficient in migrating websites, installing and updating themes and plugins

▸ Performs the full range of digital marketing activities, including implementing responsive web design, search engine optimization (SEO) techniques, creating and scheduling social media content, running Facebook and Google Ads
positions.insights: Skills: Web Accessibility Testing · Web Development · Web Project Management

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
▸ Led a Core Team comprised of approximately 40 people across all Southern Company subsidiaries to develop responses to climate-related shareholder resolutions

▸ Engaged with all levels of the company organization, stakeholders, and legal team to communicate project status and develop deliverables such as presentations, talking points, website material and documents for external audiences

▸ Stayed abreast of environmental policy statuses, proposed environmental regulations, and peer utility activities

▸ Generated and analyzed simulation data used to determine the most economic operation of Southern Company's electric generating fleet

▸ Effectively presented budget results and trends to clients and management

▸ Performed sensitivity studies to determine the impact of factors such as fuel prices, environmental emission allowances, and plant maintenance on production costs

▸ Performed corporate oversight of the in-service testing of pumps and valves for the company's three nuclear plants, ensuring that codes of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission and quality standards of the Institution of Nuclear Power Operations were adhered to

▸ Leader of the In-Service Testing Program Technical Team, which consisted of fourteen members

▸ Coordinated fleet standardization initiatives

▸ Member of nuclear-related subcommittees of the American Society of Mechanical Engineers

Key Successes:

▸ Received a Southern Excellence Award for completing timely analysis of the impact of the Environmental Protection Agency's Cross-State Air Pollution Rule on Southern's plant operations

▸ Taught four classes to staff members on how to be a flawless consultant

 ▸ Served as Department Coordinator for Southern Company Services' 2014 United Way Campaign; led a staff of 47 people to complete participation and donation goals

positions.title: Staff Engineer, Flight Controller
positions.description:
▸ Provided real-time ascent support of Space Shuttle launches by executing software according to procedure, troubleshooting anomalies, monitoring adherence to vehicle and experience constraints, elevating areas of concern to a deciding officer, and communicating recommendations

▸ Provided pre-mission design of abort capabilities by following procedures and documenting any deviations

▸ Performed analysis of anomalous events that occurred during simulations and actual missions, programming code to synthesize large amounts of data, reporting findings to internal technical groups and external boards, recommending further courses of action 

▸ Proficient in statistical analysis methods

▸ Comfortable with various coding languages, including Python, SQL, C Shell and Fortran

▸ Proficient using Windows and Linux operating systems

▸ Facilitated a weekly technical integration meeting 

▸ Trained subsequent group members, served as acting manager on several occasions, participated in the department’s hiring process by interviewing candidates

Key Successes:

▸ Received two NASA group achievement awards in recognition of pre-flight analysis, integration, and technical expertise

▸ Received the Quest For Excellence Quarterly Award for Technical Achievement

▸ Volunteered to investigate streamlining improvements for the department’s software configuration management plan and software life cycle; designed a new form that met established requirements and ensured that all software changes were properly developed, tested, and approved; received a performance award for initiative

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
▸ Member of the Turbine Group in the Upstream Projects Procurement Sourcing department
 
▸ Learned the procurement process; assisted with maintaining vendor relationships

Key Successes:

▸ Created a guide to make the turbine procurement process more standardized and efficient.  This guide included the clear definition of the roles and responsibilities of procurement staff members, project management and engineering, suppliers, and contractors.

▸ Developed a log that captures the procurement status of all turbine purchases and global support services

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
▸ Became familiar with the operation and maintenance of equipment – compressors, turbines, pumps, generators

▸ Conducted plant maintenance surveys

▸ Performed right-of-way maintenance

▸ Updated company safety standards and codes manuals and distributed pipeline safety pamphlets to local companies.

volunteerExperiences.role: Content Manager and Help Desk Support
Guest Engineer for ASME DropMEIn! Event
volunteerExperiences.companyName: ASME (The American Society of Mechanical Engineers)
volunteerExperiences.description: Virtually visited a grade 5-8 class at Miles Park School in Cleveland Metro to share my passion for creative problem-solving and career experience as an engineer and digital marketer. ASME DropMEIn! Events bring in guest engineers to talk to students about engineering and related STEM careers open to them. This program reaches thousands of students in K-12 classrooms and schools across the country.

company.name: ASME (The American Society of Mechanical Engineers)

organizations.position: Volunteer for K-12 Programs (2022); Member of Early Career Engineer Programming Committee – Digital Engagement Team – Created and posted social media content targeting early career engineers (2019 - 2021); Member of New Reactors Operations and Maintenance (O&M) Committee Task Group (October 2011 - March 2013) · Nov 2010 - Present
